description: The first Know-promotion policy of ontology task 063 (FR-33, BR-6, D-51): 'this matter has no budget'. A Decide-lane Existence rule with a notExists clause over sprk_budget (the join sprk_budget.sprk_matter is in PredicateCompiler.VerifiedJoins since task 063), evaluated by the ONE evaluator (SignalEvaluator via the nightly SignalReevaluationJob). Applied to Dataverse by scripts/Apply-DoLanePolicies.ps1 -DefinitionPath config/know-promotion.policies.json (idempotent upsert by the fixed ids below). The policy is created with sprk_enabled = No; the owner turns it on after review, and the script never changes sprk_enabled on an existing row. A version row is immutable once published (FR-49): a changed body, plan or template is a NEW version (a new entry with a higher versionNumber and its own id), never an edit of this one. The five-day knob is the 'now-5d' in the body. The message template asserts only what the body reads (section 0.3): the matter's createdon and the absence of an ACTIVE sprk_budget row (statecode 0) joined by sprk_budget.sprk_matter. No document-based Absence rule is authored (documents are reference-mode data; deferred until documents are mirrored, BR-6). Version 2 (task 159, D-178, owner UAT round 1) keeps the rule and changes only the decision: the Decide action is assign-task (a Task, a sprk_event of type Task) instead of assign-work, and the plan offers add-todo and assign-work as Next steps. Version 3 (task 166, D-192, owner UAT round 1 re-check) keeps the rule again and changes only the decision: the plan offers revise-budget first (the server shows it as Create budget on a matter with no active budget, D-180; the plan never names create-budget) then assign-task, with add-todo and assign-work as Next steps. Versions 1 and 2 are untouched.
